title: poincianella oblongifolia
intro: Poincianella oblongifolia, commonly known as the Australian Horse Apple, is a plant species native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its leaves and fruits offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Poincianella oblongifolia include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, as well as its potential to treat wounds and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
